title: Classification of P. falciparum infection recurrences with MalReBay
text: MalReBay R package classifying recurrent Plasmodium falciparum infections Therapeutic Efficacy Studies (TES). patient, estimates probability recurrent infection recrudescence (.e. treatment failure) rather reinfection (new infection acquired different mosquito bite treatment). MalReBay uses Bayesian approach published Plucinski et al. 2015, combines available genotyping data prior information estimate probability. model uses Markov Chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) sampling obtain estimates. Key advantages MalReBay include: Handles polyclonal infections, patient can carry multiple parasite strains Imputes missing genotypes part MCMC analysis, handling missing data Works different genotyping approaches used TES: microsatellites, MSP1/MSP2/GLURP length-polymorphic markers, amplicon sequencing (AmpSeq)

title: Classification of P. falciparum infection recurrences with MalReBay
text: World Health Organization () recommends TES monitor well antimalarial drugs working: patients uncomplicated malaria treated followed several weeks check whether infection cleared stayed away. parasite reappearing follow-can mean one two things, look clinically identical: Recrudescence: original infection never fully cleared drug sign treatment failure. New infection (reinfection): new, unrelated infection different mosquito bite sign drug failed. Molecular correction tells two types recurrences apart comparing parasite genetic fingerprint Day 0 fingerprint later time recurrence. MalReBay performs comparison Bayesian model. patient, MalReBay asks: given genotyping data hand, much consistent pattern alleles “infection persisting” “new, unrelated infection”?  Overview MalReBay framework. Prior: seeing genetic data, recrudescence reinfection assumed equally likely (50/50). Likelihood: model asks well hypothesis (recrudescence reinfection) explains observed alleles, accounting common allele local parasite population, many parasite clones sample carries (polyclonal infections), marker-specific genotyping noise. Posterior: prior likelihood combined via Bayes’ rule, final probability recrudescence per patient compared user-defined threshold (0.5 default) get Recrudescence/New infection classification call.
